verdict.rationale: Khoj's documented Automations feature runs a user-defined query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency and emails the research results. That is a first-party trigger-to-action capability, but it is limited to time-based schedules with a single email output. Missing for 10: event-driven triggers beyond schedules (e.g., file changes, new data, webhooks), conditional rule logic, a choice of actions beyond email delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automations.
